introHtml: Custom non-slip headbands and wristbands keep your logo visible and comfortable during active use. Whether you are outfitting a race team or equipping warehouse staff, the silicone grip lining prevents shifting and absorbs moisture. Choose from terry or microfiber fabrics, and add your full-color imprint via screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that stays put through any task.
heroAltText: Custom non-slip headbands and wristbands with silicone grip lining, perfect for sports and safety teams.
